meta.note: Transport Canada says not to fly closer than 5.6 km (3 nautical miles) to an airport listed as certified in the Canada Flight Supplement, or 1.9 km (1 nautical mile) to a certified heliport, unless you follow an established procedure. This circle is drawn at every airport in the open data, certified or not, so it shows more places than the rule covers. Heliports are not shown. Military aerodromes need permission from the Department of National Defence.
